source.author: stat
source.text: semper honoratam dimensis orbibus anni te domus ista colet; nigri tibi, diva, litabunt electa cervice greges, lustraliaque exta lacte novo perfusus edet Vulcanius ignis.
source.text_original: semper honoratam dimensis orbibus anni / te domus ista colet; nigri tibi, diva, litabunt / electa cervice greges, lustraliaque exta / lacte novo perfusus edet Vulcanius ignis.
source.text_english: This house shall always worship you, honored, through the measured cycles of the year; for you, goddess, chosen herds with black necks shall be sacrificed, and the Vulcanian fire, sprinkled with new milk, shall consume the lustral entrails.

reuse.author: val
reuse.text: vestris egomet tune vellera templis illa dabo, dabit auratis et cornibus igni colla pater, niveique greges altaria cingent.
reuse.text_original: vestris egomet tune vellera templis / illa dabo, dabit auratis et cornibus igni / colla pater, niveique greges altaria cingent.
reuse.text_english: Shall I myself then give those fleeces to your temples? Their father shall give his neck to the gilded fire, and snowy flocks shall surround the altars.
